name: v2-fast-nodes
purpose: Replace the 18-node rule set with a small set of fast, price-and-liquidity nodes, adaptive thresholds, count-based sizing and one inflation overlay.
why_v1_failed: v1 stacked many correlated nodes, several of them slow (Sahm, CFNAI, WEI) or level-based (credit spread, curve, inflation), so it stayed defensive through rebounds and held a permanent cash drag. v2 uses fewer, faster nodes, requires two to agree before acting, and sets thresholds from trailing data only.
timing: Decide at Friday close using only data published by then (conservative lags). Weights earn the following week. Weekly rebalance to target, turnover measured against drifted weights.

adaptive_thresholds.note: Percentiles use the trailing window of weekly observations strictly BEFORE the decision date. No threshold is estimated from any evaluation window.

fast_nodes.meaning: Baa minus 10y spread widening unusually fast (4-week change)

sizing.rule: Count how many fast nodes are on. 0 or 1: neutral. Exactly 2: tier_2. 3 or 4: tier_3.

overlay.note: Fixed levels, not fitted. Added to whatever tier is active. One node only, so inflation cannot stack.

development.equity_note: FRED carries the S&P 500 only from 2016-11, so the Nasdaq Composite price index stands in as the equity sleeve. Every strategy and benchmark in this window uses it.

confirmation.equity_note: NOT a clean out-of-sample test: the designer had already seen v1's results in this window.

criteria.C1: Development window: 90% block-bootstrap interval (block 8 weeks, 2000 draws, seed 0) for annualized excess return versus static_mix_same_average_weights has a lower bound above 0.
criteria.C2: Development window: maximum drawdown is shallower than buy_and_hold_neutral by at least 2 percentage points.
criteria.C3: Development window: Sharpe ratio versus cash is at least that of buy_and_hold_neutral.
criteria.C4: Confirmation window: annualized excess versus static_mix_same_average_weights is greater than -0.5%.
criteria.verdict: PASS only if C1, C2, C3 and C4 all hold. Otherwise FAIL.

on_failure: If the verdict is FAIL, no parameter is changed and re-run under this name. A new design needs a new name, a new file and a new lock. A PASS is a reason to paper-trade forward from the lock date, not to trade.
disclosures: Designed after seeing v1's 2020-2026 results, so the confirmation window cannot validate it.
No strategy returns for 2006-2019 had been computed by the designer before this registration; only data availability for that window was checked.
Stocks are price-only (no dividends); Treasuries and credit are duration-based proxies without defaults.
Revised series (core PCE, NFCI, financial stress) are used as last revised, so some revision look-ahead remains.
One specification, one run per window. Four criteria were fixed in advance.
